text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's finally time for my debut! ♪ My
legend starts
here!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's expecting me to run well.
And because
of that...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The challenge-seeker in me is itching to
do
something absolutely wild! For
example...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Imagine if I went off to buy a bento box
during
the race and still won!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have a good understanding of Seeking
the
Pearl's personality now, which is why
I came
prepared.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
choice_data_list: テーブルの上を見て、パール！

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Wow, what an exquisite selection of
bentos!
What's more, there's cuisine here
from all around
the world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
choice_data_list: どれでも好きなのを食べていいから
choice_data_list_en: You can eat whichever one you like.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! You've outdone yourself,
Trainer! You
anticipated my impulses so
perfectly, I won't need
to go buy lunch
myself anymore.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
All right. Since you're so dedicated to
keeping me
focused, I'll do just that and
keep my eyes on the
finish line.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'll show the girl who's here to watch the
race just
how well I can run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's little doubt about which girl
Seeking the
Pearl is referring to.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha. I knew you'd come, Taiki. After
all, when it
comes to our generation...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's just you and me! I don't think there's
anyone
else who can keep up with us.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And that's why I need to shock you with
what I
can do!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
See for yourself just how excellent my
running is,
and get blown away by my
passionate and
stunning debut!
